top_signals.title: Gold Set for Worst Week Since March on Hawkish Fed
top_signals.summary: Gold fell and was heading for the biggest weekly decline since March, as a hawkish Federal Reserve signaled more interest-rate hikes and a selloff in AI stocks pushed investors to sell the metal to cover losses.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Dollar Heads for Fourth Week of Gains Following Anthropic IPO
top_signals.summary: The dollar is headed for a fourth straight weekly gain as demand tied to the Anthropic PBC IPO further lifts the currency that has been supported by expectations of further Federal Reserve interest-rate hikes and elevated US Treasury yields.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Iran intensifies Hormuz tanker attacks just as oil prices slide
top_signals.summary: It remains difficult to gauge how badly vessels are being hit as producers tend to remain tight-lipped due to security concerns.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
